name: Wizard OS 0.3.54 — backup and repaired onboarding
about: Combine the exact 0.3.50 backup/restore, Voice and Connection Router bundle with official main UX through #533, including the #531 Done rotation/Skip repair and #535 native-safe-area correction. Only the UX component, image and default shell pin change. Feature-classified; latest only. Stable remains 0.3.53 until new-version fresh install, upgrades from 0.3.39/0.3.40/0.3.53, backup/restore/Undo and first-chat/phone acceptance pass. Preserve the complete 0.3.49 backup/restore, Voice and Connection Router bundle. Change only the UX source, official image and shell source to published main 03b07142: readable iPhone first-run guidance, signed Android 1.0.1 companion integration and James-approved one-agent Spaces. Feature-classified; latest only until exact released-source fresh/current-stable upgrade and inherited backup/restore/Undo acceptance pass. Published 0.3.48 bundle with WAM #230: root-owned owner-files and Runtipi trees use the existing descriptor-anchored privilege helper for key creation, discovery, metadata, version checks, import and Undo; denied-host boundaries remain fail-closed. All other source, image and default-app pins are unchanged. Latest only; fresh installs, upgrades from 0.3.39/0.3.40 and released-source backup/restore/Undo remain required. Published 0.3.47 bundle with WAM #228: exact Agent Service coordination databases and SQLite sidecars remain local and keep their live inodes across backup import and Undo. Owner metadata and owner SQLite journals remain captured and compared. Backward-compatible Undo ignores only those coordination fingerprints and does not replay saved coordination inodes from older journals. Real installed-CLI synthetic round trip passed on a retained 0.3.47 ARM guest with the fixed backup modules: export/verify/import/receipt, distinct-baseline Undo with exact digest, and newer-app refusal with unchanged refused scopes. Latest only; fresh install and upgrades from 0.3.39/0.3.40 with the released source remain required. Published 0.3.46 bundle, with WAM #226 fixing fresh installs that exhaust loginctl enable-linger retries after systemd package upgrades. Root-only fallback sets the linger flag and starts user@UID.service, restoring SELinux labels when available; ordinary non-root behavior is unchanged. All non-WAM pins, images and default apps remain exactly 0.3.46. Latest only; fresh/upgrade/backup release gates are still required. Published 0.3.45 bundle, with WAM #223 selecting noninteractive sudo for the same local Docker socket when the owner’s Docker-group membership is not yet active. Sanitized child environments, streamed helpers and bounded environment-scoped access caching are covered by regression tests and a daemon-free Thales subprocess probe. Fresh/upgrade/backup release gates are still required; this cut is latest only. Published 0.3.44 bundle (including Voice and Connection Router defaults), with WAM #221 fixing owner-user backup discovery, metadata reads and restore/Undo of root-only container-owned agent trees. 0.3.40 bundle with WAM main through #213: backup/restore #61 (verified encrypted export/import, paused cron/messaging/backups and Undo, Mac companion engine), report and strict contact #166, install retry #209; non-author review fixes kept-app credential loss, durable app/volume Undo archives, kept-tree interrupted-swap recovery and confirmed agent stops. All non-WAM pins remain 0.3.40; does not take the separately reserved 0.3.41 defaults/UI candidate. Small tester group only. Known limitations: Wizard scheduler is not paused/checkpointed/reconciled; stop source Service before export, inspect schedules with destination stopped/offline. AI login refresh is not fenced by activation: old box off before import or destination offline until exclusive handover. Tailscale and external alongside/linked grants re-enrol. Not an online clone. James explicitly waived the 72h latest soak on 25 Oct 2026; stable promotion still requires fresh install, upgrades from 0.3.39 and 0.3.40, and new-version backup/restore evidence.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Main through #230: repair root-owned owner-files/Runtipi backup permission boundaries across key creation, discovery, metadata, version checks, import and Undo, preserving denied-host regressions. All declared image inputs remain identical to attested 80c76cf.

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; c434bbe plus #9 (connection app links follow apps.json; no dead Claude button when Claude Code is missing).

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main through #151; preserves final #149 guards after #150 supersession.

wizard-ux.note: Official main through #533, including the reviewed #531/#535 Done rotation, reachable Skip, native-safe-area and short-screen scroll corrections. Onboarding runtime and regression files match stable 26c3b20 except one comment. Inherits main features merged since 0.3.50: workspace sync, scoped Spaces, thread follow-up controls, shared composer and app media viewer. This is a feature release, not a fix-only backport. No changes to non-UX pins.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official multi-arch main image from 80c76cf, workflow run 40171067383. Attestation reverified; all declared image inputs and workflow are byte-identical through 44fded38. Python backup engine is host-installed WAM source, not an image input.

shell.note: Alongside installs use the immutable official image above; index drift is informational.

ai-connection.note: Host Hermes owns and renews its sign-in; the connection app reads sanitized usage through the wizard-os dashboard plugin. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Installed on every box next to ChatGPT. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude, so Connect/Test and auto-renew act on the agent's sign-in; tokens are never copied.

secrets.note: secret-drop #1: the engine image is pinned by its multi-arch digest (secret-drop:0.1.1@sha256:29ebc6a7…c03302), the same bytes as the 0.1.1 tag in 0.3.19.

hermes.test_record: none: carried over from 0.3.21, pinned before Wizard stable existed

notes: 0.3.54: exact 0.3.50 non-UX source/image/default-app pins and Hermes block retained; UX uses the first main merge containing the complete reviewed onboarding repair, not newer unneeded main changes. Official multi-arch image provenance verified. James chose Stable 0.3.53 now, then a new backup+onboarding release for latest and exact-release acceptance before promotion. Earlier 0.3.50 passes are not acceptance for this release. Backup scheduler, AI-login exclusive handover, Tailscale re-enrolment and external-grant limitations remain as documented above. No Stable promotion is included.
